offering_description.value: Sells vacation ownership interests to leisure travelers, who can use points or reserved weeks to stay at resorts. It operates resorts, finances purchases, and rents accommodations by the night. It also runs an exchange network for timeshare owners and provides property management for owners’ associations.

primary_products.value: Points-based vacation ownership interests; deeded timeshare interests

primary_services.value: Resort and property management; vacation ownership financing; nightly accommodation rentals; timeshare exchange; resort affiliation services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Vacation ownership buyers, timeshare exchange members, and leisure travelers booking resort stays; B2B: Vacation ownership associations, resort developers, and independent resort operators

end_markets.value: Vacation ownership; leisure travel and resort lodging; timeshare exchange; resort property management

revenue_model.value: product sales: Upfront purchases of vacation ownership interests and additional points; service fees: Resort and association management, resort operations, and related services; rental or leasing: Nightly resort accommodations booked by travelers; interest or premiums: Interest on loans used to purchase vacation ownership interests; subscription: Recurring timeshare exchange membership dues; transaction or usage fees: Individual accommodation exchanges and related travel bookings
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing; interest or premiums; subscription; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Develops or acquires resort inventory and makes it available to vacation owners and nightly guests; service provider: Manages resort operations and common areas for vacation ownership associations; software / platform: Aggregates accommodation inventory from affiliated resorts and members for timeshare exchanges; financial intermediary: Originates installment loans for vacation ownership purchasers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Resorts in the United States, Caribbean, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with a worldwide exchange network

specialization.value: related lines: Vacation ownership, resort management, purchase financing, accommodation rentals, and timeshare exchange

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams sell ownership interests to prospective buyers and existing owners; own locations: Resort sales centers host tours and vacation ownership presentations; online: Company websites offer resort bookings, exchange reservations, and ownership inquiries; partners / resellers: Affiliated resort developers introduce their owners to the exchange network
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State timeshare registration and sales licensing requirements, plus federal and state consumer credit rules for purchase financing

notes: The current scope of third-party property management outside vacation ownership is uncertain.
